programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Star Light, Star Bright"
programme.desc: The two current science missions to our star; the sun have made great leaps forward in the science of how stars work, how they generate solar winds and how they affect their orbiting planets. This lets us look at other stars with great understanding.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Moon Shine"
programme.desc: The International drive to return to the Moon is gathering pace. We look at what resources scientists and engineers are looking to extract from Lunar regolith and Martian soil.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "World Wide Wifi"
programme.desc: How will “world wide wifi” change the world again?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Strange Space Recipes"
programme.desc: Survival anywhere requires that we adapt to our surroundings but how will humans adapt to survive in space?

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Final Years"
programme.desc: THE SPACE SHUTTLE MATURES - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. COMPLEX CONSTRUCTION IN SPACE - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers forget the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The Launchers"
programme.desc: This episode examines a range of launchers that are integral to space research.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the work of the probes orbiting Mars and the rovers exploring its surface.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Saturn"
programme.desc: This episode reveals the work done by the Cassini probe that spent more than 13 years examining the Saturnian system.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The International Space Station"
programme.desc: This episode exposes the working life of people who spend months orbiting in micro gravity.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: The next generation of Earth observation satellites are now in place maintaining the continuity of long-term climate data. Scientists are concerned the rate is increasing beyond expectations and glacier melting continues unabated.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Earths Evil Twin"
programme.desc: Venus once may have been as hospitable to life as Earth is now. Then something changed and Venus became shrouded in hot dense toxic clouds. There are now plans to send advanced probes to the surface of Venus and find out what happened to our twin.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Increasing Orbit"
programme.desc: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Mountains In The Dark"
programme.desc: Asteroids, the debris from the early solar system hold tantalizing clues to planetary formation. The spacecraft Psyche readies to study a unique metallic asteroid. As Lucy is on its way to the trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Declaring Martian Law"
programme.desc: Space is home to crucial resources, important discoveries, and big potential profit.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Sol Ownership: Can A Corporation Own The Sun?"
programme.sub-title: Sol Ownership: Can A Corporation Own The Sun?
programme.desc: Human needs have always created opportunities for human greed. And energy might be the most crucial need of all. Could we end up paying a subscription fee for sunlight?

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Life Beyond Earth"
programme.desc: We look closely at the search within our solar system, Mars, Titan and the ice moons. Speaking with experts in their fields of Mars robotic missions, Nuclear scientists probing the structure of ice on the distant moons.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "The Next Great Extinction Event"
programme.desc: Experts explain our history and evolution of Earth over its 4 billion year history and take us through to the current emergency where humans may be one of the species to become extinct.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Bobcat"
programme.desc: Prey can become play, for this solitary hunter sometimes pesters its captured quarry to death. Easily confused with its cousin, the Lynx, the Bobcat flourishes in close proximity to humans.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "The Grouse and the Goshawk"
programme.desc: Intimately linked together are two birds -- the speedy Goshawk and the alert Ruffed Grouse. Many predators pursue the Grouse, but none is so well-adapted to catch it as the Goshawk.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Killer Mice"
programme.desc: Through the night, a ravenous predator stalks its unwary prey. With a swift bite to the skull, it slays the victim, then throws back its head and howls.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "North Woods Lynx"
programme.desc: Elegant and graceful, the Lynx is one of Nature's finest physical specimens. Its primary quarry is the elusive Snowshoe Hare. This fascinating, unexplained phenomenon is only one of many mysteries in the Great North Woods.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Queen of the Ice"
programme.desc: The mother Polar Bear is admired for her beauty, ferocity and patience. In a frigid landscape, a Polar Bear emerges from her maternity den with cubs.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "River of Bears"
programme.desc: Cocaine Bear has nothing on this show. Watch as more than one hundred massive Brown Bears line up along the McNeil River in Alaska. Each Bear stakes out and defends its fishing territory.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Time of the Grizzly"
programme.desc: The Grizzly Bear is funny and ferocious, a quivering coward and a daring hero, easily tamed yet forever wild. This disappearing giant is one of the most contradictory and complex of all our animal ideas.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "White on White"
programme.desc: On the Arctic tundra, predator and prey alike are aided by fur or feathers the color of snow. Some, like the Gyrfalcon and Snowy Owl, stay white year round. Others, like Ptarmigan and Snowshoe Hare, turn white for winter.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "The Wolf and the Whitetail"
programme.desc: In the wilderness, the seasons are everything. From Summer to Fall, from Winter to Spring, the lives of the wild animals are bound to the year long rhythm of life and death. For the survivors of Winter's harsh test, Spring is a time of renewal.

programme.title: Wild America S9 - "Wolverine Country"
programme.desc: It's the mountainous home of a legendary creature: the Wolverine. It's been called a ravenous monster, a supernatural being, even 'skunk bear' thanks to its skunky aroma.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Bushytails"
programme.desc: If you walk through a forest anywhere in North America, you're likely to hear the scolding chatter of a tree Squirrel. These lively creatures are among our most popular and visible wild animals.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Controversial Coyote"
programme.desc: To some of us,this mournful cry kindles delight and inspiration,to others dread and hatred. In Indian mythology,the coyote was revered for its cleverness and mystical song.Yet our modern society condemns the Coyote for its predatory instinct to kill.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Cottontails And Kin"
programme.desc: The Cottontail is perhaps the most prominent character in American folklore, but bedtime stories hardly reflect the daily struggle for survival of real life Rabbits.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Family of Foxes"
programme.desc: In French, the Fox is called "Reynard", meaning "unconquerable through his cleverness". Is this charming canid as crafty as the fables portray? Does it deserve its reputation as henhouse bandit?

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Just Little Varmints"
programme.desc: From the Arctic Ground Squirrel of Alaska and the Golden-mantled of the Rockies to the ubiquitous Prairie Dog, our concealed cameras shed light on why these under-appreciated little critters allow us all to enjoy Nature's most magnificent species.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Managing Wildlife"
programme.desc: Managing wildlife most often means managing humans -- the primary predator in virtually all our ecosystems. Through this complex, but vital, process, we constantly try to balance our own conflicting interests with those of our native wild creatures.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Old Man Muskrat"
programme.desc: This medium sized rodent lives anywhere it can find plant food and still water. A diligent worker, it's always swimming, digging, or eating. Beady eyed and all business, it can be quarrelsome.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Ringtailed Rascals"
programme.desc: We're fascinated by the Jaguar's spots, the Skunk's stripes, and the Raccoon's mask and Ringtailed. Maybe it's because these characteristic markings enable us to identify them easier and they even add an extra dimension to their personalities.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 1"
programme.desc: A creature chosen by the Pilgrims for the first Thanksgiving meal that's now a rarity in Nature. Our largest gamebird with its flamboyant courtship.

programme.title: Wild America S10 - "Wild Turkey Part 2"
programme.desc: Part 2 continues to explore the wild turkey as one of game management's greatest success stories. Our traditional symbol of Nature's abundance was once feared to be gone as a gamebird due to overhunting by humans and a loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Winter In The Swiss Alps"
programme.desc: Get to know a comparatively unknown corner of Switzerland, the Jura region. The film is a journey of discovery into almost untouched nature in the change of the seasons. The Jura Mountains are the little brother of the Alps

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "The Jura Mountains"
programme.desc: The ibex, marmot, and European adder have all developed strategies to survive the alpine winter.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Ticino"
programme.desc: Learn about four different regions of Switzerland. From the rugged mountains of the Ticino High Alps to the lovely Muggio Valley in the southernmost corner of Ticino, hardly any other canton is so full of contrasts.
